mapper.select: SELECT * FROM garage_zone WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM garage_zone WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY level ASC, sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT zone_id AS zoneId, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN archive_status = 'ARCHIVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS archivedCount FROM light_group GROUP BY zone_id
SELECT * FROM garage_zone ORDER BY id ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE garage_zone SET zone_code = #{zone.zoneCode}, zone_name = #{zone.zoneName}, parent_id = #{zone.parentId}, level = #{zone.level}, sort_order = #{zone.sortOrder}, status = #{zone.status}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{zone.id} AND version = #{zone.version}
UPDATE garage_zone SET level = #{level} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT 'CHILD_ZONE' AS type, '子分区' AS typeText, z.id AS zoneId, z.zone_name AS zoneName, z.zone_code AS refNo, CONCAT('仍存在子分区[', z.zone_name, '（', z.zone_code, '）]，请先清空或删除全部子分区') AS detail FROM garage_zone z WHERE z.parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY z.sort_order ASC, z.id ASC

SELECT 'OPEN_TRANSFER_LEDGER' AS type, '未核销划转流水' AS typeText, ref.zone_id AS zoneId, z.zone_name AS zoneName, l.batch_no AS refNo, CONCAT('未核销划转流水[', l.batch_no, ']仍引用分区[', COALESCE(z.zone_name, CONCAT('#', ref.zone_id)), ']，请先在操作台账中核销') AS detail FROM ( SELECT l.id, l.target_zone_id AS zone_id FROM batch_transfer_ledger l WHERE l.settle_status = 'OPEN' AND l.target_zone_id IN #{zoneId} UNION SELECT l.id, d.source_zone_id AS zone_id FROM batch_transfer_ledger l INNER JOIN ledger_detail d ON d.ledger_id = l.id WHERE l.settle_status = 'OPEN' AND d.source_zone_id IN #{zoneId} UNION SELECT l.id, d.target_zone_id AS zone_id FROM batch_transfer_ledger l INNER JOIN ledger_detail d ON d.ledger_id = l.id WHERE l.settle_status = 'OPEN' AND d.target_zone_id IN #{zoneId} ) ref INNER JOIN batch_transfer_ledger l ON l.id = ref.id LEFT JOIN garage_zone z ON z.id = ref.zone_id GROUP BY ref.id, ref.zone_id, z.zone_name, l.batch_no ORDER BY l.batch_no ASC LIMIT #{limit}
